description: 法務部對有關「苗栗縣下水道管理自治條例修正草案」之空間資訊議題提出法制意見 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 法務部法制司. 113年1月29日法務部法制字第11302503290號法制意見. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 法務部法制司. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
